question: What is the primary purpose of development committees in the Nigerian Primary Health Care system?

options.A: To completely replace professional nurses in rural clinics
options.B: To promote community ownership, participation, and decentralized governance
options.C: To handle international monetary loans for the federal government
options.D: To audit private pharmaceutical manufacturing companies

explanation: These committees are designed to bridge the gap between providers and the community by fostering local participation and ownership in healthcare delivery. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h1)

question: Which agency coordinates the primary health care development guidelines in Nigeria that support these committees?

options.A: National Primary Health Care Development Agency (NPHCDA)

explanation: The NPHCDA provides the overarching guidelines and framework for establishing and running community-based PHC management structures in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h1)

question: At which level of governance does the Village Development Committee (VDC) operate?
explanation: The VDC is positioned directly at the grassroots or settlement level to serve as the foundational unit of community mobilization. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h2)

question: Who typically makes up the membership of a Village Development Committee?

options.C: Traditional leaders, youth, women, and religious figures

explanation: VDCs comprise key local stakeholders including traditional leaders, youth representatives, women's leaders, and religious figures. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h2)

question: What is the primary focus of the Health Facility Development Committee (HFDC)?

options.B: Administering, maintaining, and overseeing a specific health facility
options.D: Inspecting secondary and tertiary teaching hospitals

explanation: The HFDC is dedicated to the direct administration, maintenance, and operational efficiency of a specific health facility. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h3)

question: Who serves as a crucial professional member of the HFDC alongside community stakeholders?

options.A: The Officer-in-Charge (OIC) of the health facility

explanation: The Officer-in-Charge (OIC) of the clinic is a key member, working alongside community representatives to manage facility operations. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of the District Development Committee (DDC)?

options.A: To replace the federal ministry of health
options.B: To coordinate health activities and harmonize plans across multiple villages and facilities in a district
options.C: To manufacture pharmaceutical drugs for the country
options.D: To issue nursing licenses and practice stamps

explanation: The DDC acts as an intermediate structure that coordinates health activities, aggregates reports, and harmonizes plans across multiple villages and facilities. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h4)

question: Which stakeholders typically form part of the District Development Committee?

options.A: Heads of VDCs/HFDCs and local health supervisors within the district
options.C: Only newborn babies and their mothers

explanation: The DDC comprises leaders from lower-level committees (VDCs and HFDCs), local health supervisors, and civic leaders within that specific district. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h4)

question: Who typically chairs the Local Government Area Primary Health Care Development Committee (LGA-PHCDC)?

options.A: The President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
options.B: The Chairman of the Local Government Council
options.C: The Head Nurse of the local maternity ward
options.D: The Director-General of World Health Organization

explanation: The LGA-PHCDC is typically chaired by the Chairman of the Local Government Council to ensure strong political and administrative commitment. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h5)

question: Who serves as the secretary of the LGA-PHCDC?

options.D: The Chief Judge of the State High Court

explanation: The LGA PHC Coordinator serves as the administrative secretary, managing day-to-day coordination alongside the committee chair. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h5)

question: At which administrative tier does the State Implementation Committee (SIC) operate?
explanation: The SIC operates at the sub-national state level to coordinate PHC activities across all LGAs within the state. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h6)

question: What is one of the primary responsibilities of the State Implementation Committee?

options.A: Monitoring state-wide health indicators and providing technical support to LGAs
options.B: Building residential houses for local chiefs

explanation: The SIC oversees state-wide health indicators (like immunization rates) and provides technical assistance and policy guidance to LGAs. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h6)

question: Where does the National Policy Implementation Committee (NPIC) sit within the Nigerian health system?

options.B: At the apex of the primary health care governance structure
options.C: At the individual clinic waiting room
options.D: At the local market stall level

explanation: The NPIC operates at the apex of the PHC governance structure, handling national policies, standards, and inter-state coordination. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h7)

question: Which federal bodies primarily guide and convene the National Policy Implementation Committee?

options.A: NPHCDA and the Federal Ministry of Health
options.B: Federal Ministry of Works and Housing

explanation: The NPHCDA and the Federal Ministry of Health convene and guide the NPIC to ensure uniform national health standards and policies. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h7)

question: Which of the following is a major challenge commonly faced by development committees in Nigeria?

options.C: Too many trained nurses available in rural areas

explanation: Development committees frequently struggle with poor funding, lack of training, apathy, and political interference that renders them inactive. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h8)

question: What is an effective strategy to improve the operational effectiveness of these committees?

options.B: Regular capacity building, leadership training, and transparent financial tracking
options.C: Relying entirely on foreign loans without local input

explanation: Providing regular training, leadership capacity building, and transparent tracking systems helps revitalize and sustain committee operations. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T7#GNS124_U1_T7_h8)
